utterance.text: Hi, can I check in early tomorrow morning, and is there an extra fee?

short.text: I'm sorry, I don't have that information. I can help you with hotel-related questions instead.

typical.text: The gym at Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites is open 24 hours for registered guests. Appropriate workout attire and athletic footwear are required, and equipment should be cleaned after use. Guests under 16 must be supervised by an adult.

long.text: At Grand Horizon Hotel & Suites, we offer a variety of vegan dishes across all dining outlets. You can choose from salads, soups, plant-based curries, pasta, rice bowls, and dairy-free desserts. Customized vegan meals can also be prepared upon request. Please inform the restaurant staff of your dietary preferences before ordering.
